title: Cisco email security vulnerabilities
leadParagraph: Cisco has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in Cisco Email Security Appliance (ESA) and Cisco Secure Email and Web Manager. Exploitation of this vulnerability could allow for an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to the web-based management interface of the affected device.
contentHtml:
Cisco has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in Cisco Email Security Appliance (ESA) and Cisco Secure Email and Web Manager. Exploitation of this vulnerability could allow for an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to the web-based management interface of the affected device.

TT-CSIRT strongly encourages administrators to review the following releases from Cisco and apply the necessary workarounds/updates immediately:

  • External Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
  • Information Disclosure Vulnerability
